design.stellar_transport: 1 transaction, 4 ManageData operations (names SBR-1-DOI-1..4), fee 100 stroops total, 200-stroop ledger max fee
design.xrp_rail: 4 pre-signed AccountSet transactions (sequences 107745093-107745096, fee 10 drops each), submitted in one burst, memo hex(SQDR+0x06+digest)

gates: G1 payloads frozen in this prereg before broadcast
G2 scope stamp before first submission
G3 keyless byte-exact read-back of all 8 anchors
payload_doctrine: Envelope SQDR + 0x06 + SHA-256(ASCII DOI string), 37 bytes per anchor; hex-ASCII on XRP MemoData, raw bytes as Stellar ManageData values. Digest class 0x06 = DOI binding (deterministic, keyless-verifiable: hash the DOI string, compare).
purpose: Speed/cost test of the routing doctrine from ledger 0261: XRP as the rail of record (one anchor tx per DOI), Stellar as the transport (all four DOIs bundled in one transaction). Four distinct DOI bindings fired in one burst.
